subject: Mental Models
title: Asymmetric Risk
description: Learn Asymmetric Risk in one minute.

hook.text: A startup founder risks $10,000 for a chance at $10 million. A retiree risks $10,000 and cannot earn it back.

buildup.text: Asymmetric risk means the upside and downside of a decision are not equal.

discovery.text: Nassim Taleb calls favorable asymmetry convexity.

twist.text: Most people focus on the probability of winning. But the size of the payoff matters more.

climax.text: Seek positive asymmetry. Structure decisions so that being wrong costs little but being right pays enormously.

punchline.text: Seek bets where wins dwarf losses.

quiz.question: What does Nassim Taleb call favorable asymmetric risk?
